title: Sunnies Run 2026 Review: RUNRIO's Sunglasses-Brand Race at Ayala Triangle
seo_title: Sunnies Run 2026 Review | Makati Philippines Race
meta_description: Sunnies Run 2026: October 4 at Ayala Triangle, Makati. A RUNRIO-produced, Sunnies Studios-branded road race in Manila's financial district.
dek: Set for 4 October 2026 at Ayala Triangle in Makati, this RUNRIO-produced race is branded by Sunnies Studios — the Filipino eyewear brand. A lifestyle-brand race in Manila's financial heart.
verdict: Sunnies Run is a RUNRIO-produced, Sunnies Studios-branded road race at Ayala Triangle — Makati's premier urban park in the heart of the Philippines' financial district. The Sunnies Studios brand (a popular Filipino eyewear and lifestyle label) gives the race a distinctive lifestyle-culture positioning. RUNRIO's production ensures professional race-day operations. October in Makati is the tail of the wet season. For runners wanting a brand-backed, professionally-produced Manila race with lifestyle-culture cachet, this is a unique pick.
